race.comment: NOBLE (1) improved sharply with the blinkers on for the first time, scoring here by half a length 2 weeks ago when storming home late from near last. He only needs another genuine pace up top, for him to have the last say again. VORTISTAR (2) franked some good trial form by leading all the way here fresh up to score comfortably. He cops another wide draw, but with a 4kg claiming apprentice in the irons this time, his intentions are clear, and he will be trying to repeat the dose off the front again. NOVALARGO (3) stuck to her task gamely fresh up when finishing second here 3 weeks ago, and from the pole position, she can receive a run to suit her again. Hard to beat. DUBAI AFFAIR (4) is a progressive mare resuming from a spell, and she has won the latest of her 2 trials this season. She only needs luck from a tricky gate to be an each-way threat in this. STAR WALKIN' (8) resumes from a spell, and he has trialled up twice. He would like a wet track and should be kept very safe.
